items.title: MediAsas: Affordable Assurance At The Expense Of Meaningful Health Care Protection? — Dr Mohamed Rafick Khan
items.summary: The main weakness in the argument for MediAsas is touting affordable premiums rather than comprehensive health care protection. Assurance should protect against financial catastrophe, not merely cover the average hospital bill. Another issue is copayments. The post MediAsas: Affordable Assurance At The Expense Of Meaningful Health Care Protection? — Dr Mohamed Rafick Khan appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Regaining Your Life After Stroke Is Possible, Say SMCV Experts
items.summary: Stroke recovery can take months or years, but rehab helps survivors regain lost functions and independence, say SMCV consultants. From conventional therapies to rTMS, recovery requires sustained care after hospital discharge. The post Regaining Your Life After Stroke Is Possible, Say SMCV Experts appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MOF Studying Potential Refund Of RM377m Nicotine Vape Tax After Court Ruling
items.summary: MOF is studying a potential need to refund vape businesses RM377 million in excise duties collected on nicotine vapes after a High Court ruling six months ago. Finance Minister Anwar says MOF is seeking MOH's response on the direction of vape products. The post MOF Studying Potential Refund Of RM377m Nicotine Vape Tax After Court Ruling appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Act 852 Unproven In Combating Vape: Ex-Poisons Board Member
items.summary: Former Poisons Board member Dr Ashok Philip says Act 852 is unproven in enforcement against vape and liquid nicotine should remain on the Poisons List. Galen Centre's Azrul says the sale of nicotine vape is illegal today, pending a new exemption order. The post Act 852 Unproven In Combating Vape: Ex-Poisons Board Member appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Dzulkefly Touts Eventual End Of Emergency Green Zone
items.summary: Dr Dzul tells Parliament that he wants to eventually eliminate the Green Zone for non-critical cases in the emergency units of public hospitals and redirect patients to KKs and private GPs. He also confirms the discontinuation of Skim Perubatan Madani. The post Dzulkefly Touts Eventual End Of Emergency Green Zone appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MediAsas Pilot Recorded Zero Claims, Sample Size Too Small: PAC
items.summary: The PAC flags the MediAsas pilot’s failure to test a process for approving or denying policyholders’ claims as no claims were recorded. The pilot’s sample size of 1,600 in Klang Valley, limited to staff of GLCs and insurers, was small and unrepresentative. The post MediAsas Pilot Recorded Zero Claims, Sample Size Too Small: PAC appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Where Aged Care Reform Meets Real Life — Greg King
items.summary: Reform will not be judged by the laws we pass or the standards we publish. It will be judged by what happens to the older person with dementia, the older person with no family left, the older person moving between agencies that do not speak to each other. The post Where Aged Care Reform Meets Real Life — Greg King appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Declare All Smoking Products As Haram — MCTC
items.summary: If tobacco and vape products are deemed prohibited (haram) under the relevant fatwas, the implications should not be confined solely to the act of smoking or vaping. Wider commercial activities involving these products should also be examined. The post Declare All Smoking Products As Haram — MCTC appeared first on CodeBlue .
